name: Cursed Mail
description: 10% of the mail is cursed: worth half again, but a wrong mailbox brings 4 Barbarians and an Archer on the spot, unannounced.

name: Heavy Load
description: The package mix skews one size class larger.

name: Double Raids
description: A raid comes in the first 60 s of every Delivery as well.

name: No Roads
description: The roads are dirt paths: vehicles 40% slower on them.

name: Postal Audit
description: The complaint meter decays 50% slower, and the Postal Inspector comes at 50.

name: Megamail
description: Mega enemies come twice as often.

name: Skeleton Crew
description: The quota is reckoned for two more carriers than are here.
